typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDateFilter as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFlatFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_FATAL as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_INFO as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_WARNING as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_COMPLETE as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_START as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDateFilter as string (),
	TemplateFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		MEMBER_BIRTH_DT as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		LAST_CALL_DATE as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE as string,
		PHONENUMBER_CALLED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME 	,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME 	,@STARTDATE DATETIME 	,@ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY, CASE  				WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @ENDDATE) = 2 					THEN - 3 				ELSE - 1 				END, @ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  DECLARE @temp_Members TABLE ( 	CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4) 	,CALLLIST_IID INT 	,MEMBER_IID BIGINT 	,MAX_CALLLISTMASTER_IID BIGINT 	)  INSERT INTO @temp_Members ( 	CALLLIST_CD 	,CALLLIST_IID 	,MEMBER_IID 	,MAX_CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	) SELECT CL.CALLLIST_CD 	,CL.CALLLIST_IID 	,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	,MAX(CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTMASTER_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'304\', \'307\') 	AND CONVERT(DATE, CASE  			WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) > 22 				THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) 			ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 			END) BETWEEN @STARTDATE 		AND @ENDDATE INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID GROUP BY CL.CALLLIST_CD 	,CL.CALLLIST_IID 	,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID  DECLARE @temp_Phones TABLE ( 	MEMBER_IID BIGINT 	,PHONE_IID BIGINT 	)  INSERT INTO @temp_Phones ( 	MEMBER_IID 	,PHONE_IID 	) SELECT M.MEMBER_IID 	,PHONE1.MEMBERPHONE_IID FROM @temp_Members T INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_IID = T.MEMBER_IID INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE PHONE1 ON PHONE1.MEMBERPHONE_IID = ( 		SELECT TOP 1 MEMBERPHONE_IID 		FROM PDS_MEMBERPHONE 		INNER JOIN PDS_PHONESOURCE PS1 ON PS1.PHONESOURCE_IID = MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_PHONESOURCE CP1 			ON PS1.PHONESOURCE_IID = CP1.CALLLIST_PHONESOURCE_PHONESOURCE_IID 			AND CP1.CALLLIST_PHONESOURCE_CALLLIST_IID = T.CALLLIST_IID 			AND CP1.CALLLIST_PHONESOURCE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 		WHERE MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 			AND MEMBERPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 		ORDER BY PS1.PHONESOURCE_PRIORITY ASC 			,MEMBERPHONE_IID DESC 		)  SELECT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	,M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME 	,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT, 101) AS MEMBER_BIRTH_DT 	,MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE AS MEMBER_PHONE 	,CL.CALLLIST_CD 	,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS SCRUB_DATE 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD AS SCRUB_RULE_CD 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC AS SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION 	,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITION_DT AS LAST_CALL_DATE 	,SUBSTRING(CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_PHONENUMBERCALLED, 3, 10) AS PHONENUMBER_CALLED 	,ISNULL(GENE.GENESYS_CD, \'\') AS DISPOSITIONCODE 	,CASE  		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 21 			THEN \'Cust hung up in queue\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 15 			THEN \'Member not available\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 36 			THEN \'Member Refused Survey\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 16 			THEN \'Scheduled a Manual CallBack\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 34 			THEN \'Survey Completed\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 39 			THEN \'Survey Previously Completed\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 42 			THEN \'Unintentional Hang Up\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 26 			THEN \'Member Hung Up\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 40 			THEN \'Ineligible Member\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 12 			THEN \'Interpreter Not Available\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 37 			THEN \'Member deceased\' 		WHEN GDC.GENESYSCODE = 8 			THEN \'Nursing Home/Hospital Facility\' 		ELSE ISNULL(GENE.GENE_DESC, \'\') 		END AS DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN @temp_Members T ON CL.CALLLIST_CD = T.CALLLIST_CD INNER JOIN @temp_Phones P ON T.MEMBER_IID = P.MEMBER_IID INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_IID = P.PHONE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON T.MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	AND M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD = \'NJ\' INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = T.MAX_CALLLISTMASTER_IID INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 	AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID LEFT JOIN ( 	SELECT DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 		,DISPOSITIONCODE_CD GENESYS_CD 		,DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION GENE_DESC 	FROM PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC 	WHERE DISPOSITIONCODE_SOURCE = \'GENESYS\' 	) GENE ON GENE.GENESYS_CD = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD LEFT JOIN [PDS_2008].[DBO].[PDS_GENESYS_DISPOSITIONCODE_LOOKUP] GDC ON GDC.GENESYSCODE = GENE.GENESYS_CD 	AND GDC.CALLLIST_CD  IN (\'304\', \'307\') ORDER BY M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSNJCalls
PDSNJCalls derive(SCRUB_RULE_CD_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		PHONENUMBER_CALLED_Unicode = PHONENUMBER_CALLED,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_Unicode = DISPOSITIONCODE,
		MEMBER_PHONE_Unicode = MEMBER_PHONE,
		MEMBER_BIRTH_DT_Unicode = MEMBER_BIRTH_DT,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		CALLLIST_CD_Unicode = CALLLIST_CD) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_CD_Unicode as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode as string,
		PHONENUMBER_CALLED_Unicode as string,
		LAST_CALL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_BIRTH_DT_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> NJECFExcelFile
